# Third-party browser assets

The following distributions are stored locally so the player does not depend
on mutable CDN URLs at runtime:

- hls.js 1.6.17 — Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
- dash.js 5.2.0 — BSD 3-Clause License — https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js
- Socket.IO client 4.7.5 — MIT License — https://github.com/socketio/socket.io
- Font Awesome Free 7.2.0 — Font Awesome Free License — https://fontawesome.com/license/free
- Manrope v20 — SIL Open Font License 1.1 — https://github.com/sharanda/manrope
